task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement the SWAP test in Qiskit to estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 between RY(1.508)|0> and RY(2.803)|0>. Compare the estimate from 16384 shots with the analytic overlap cos^2((1.508-2.803)/2). Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
